# chess-openings

Opening names (ECO code and name) by position, for naming a game's opening.

- Source: https://github.com/lichess-org/chess-openings, commit 3ba6b20d31b2e6125cb0e6a2e792f400717d9d39 (2026-11-05), files `a.tsv` to `e.tsv`.
- License: CC0-1.0 (public domain dedication), as stated in the repository's README ("Copyright" section) and its license metadata. Checked 2026-11-14.
- `openings.js` is generated by `core/tools/openings.mjs`: each line's moves are played and the position after them (the first four FEN fields) maps to `"ECO|Name"`.
